title: Analysis of sludge microbiomes in MBRs treating heavy oil
description: Microbiomes of activated sludge bioreactor, which treated heavy-oil containing wastewater, were analyzed by 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing and de novo assembly-based metatranscriptome analysis to decipher individual microbial functions and the heavy-oil degradation mechanism in the reactors.
center: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology
